text:
DEPARTMENT OF COMPUTER SCIENCE & ENGINEERING
APEX UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY
Date: October 24, 2024

To the Graduate Admissions Committee,

I am writing to offer my enthusiastic recommendation for Rahul Deshmukh, who I have mentored as Thesis Advisor & Course Instructor during their study period (2019-2023) at Apex University of Technology.

During this tenure, Rahul Deshmukh demonstrated exceptional mastery in C++, CUDA, Embedded Robotics, ROS2. In our research laboratory, they led the pivotal development of 'Distributed Consensus in Fault-Tolerant Blockchain Networks', exhibiting remarkable technical intuition, rigorous experimental discipline, and intellectual maturity. Additionally, the candidate maintained an exemplary academic record with a GPA of 9.4 / 10.0.

Beyond technical competence, Rahul Deshmukh displays genuine leadership, integrity, and proactive collaboration. I rank Rahul Deshmukh among the top 1% of researchers I have supervised. I strongly recommend them for admission and financial fellowship without reservation.

Warm regards,

Dr. Arvind Swaminathan
Undergraduate Peer Tutor & Lab Assistant
Computer Science & Engineering
Apex University of Technology
Email: .arvind.swaminathan@apexuniver.edu
